scoring_scheme.name: half_ppr
scoring_scheme.description: 0.5 points per reception for every position, no tight end premium, one-QB roster format.

fields.rank: Pool rank, 1..N, by points descending (ties broken by the provider's overall rank). Unique and gap-free.
fields.positional_rank: Rank within position under the same ordering.
fields.player_id: Provider player id. The only unique key — names collide.
fields.sleeper_id: Sleeper's player id (a string), for looking this player up against the league on Sleeper's API. Null when no unambiguous match exists in their player dump.
fields.name: Player name.
fields.bye_week: Team bye week; null for unsigned players.
fields.points: One-season projected fantasy points under this league's scoring: 0.5/rec, no TE premium, copied from the provider's half_ppr column.
fields.adp: 1QB ADP as an overall pick number in the source's 12-team draft (its round.pick value decoded: 2.03 -> 15). Past pick 540 the source's tail is noise, i.e. 'effectively undrafted' rather than a real slot.
